exposure: Type of cesarean section (emergency vs. planned)
outcome: Incidence of surgical site infection (SSI) after cesarean section
cohort: 520 pregnant women who underwent a cesarean section at Debre Markos Referral Hospital in Amhara region, North-west Ethiopia
finding: The incidence of SSI following cesarean section was 25.4%, with illiteracy, lack of antenatal care, previous cesarean section, HIV infection, emergency procedure, vertical incision, rupture of membranes, and multiple vaginal examinations identified as significant predictors.
